item.title: Directa Plus — G+ production
item.description:
Evidence: Documented public company (AIM DCTA) with a named product family. Exact line capacity varies by year’s report — read the filing, do not copy a slide.

Parent list: [[topics/manufacturing/directory]]

Site

Lomazzo area, Italy, is the usual production address in company materials. Confirm the current annual report before quoting floor area or t/year.

Product family

G+ graphene used in:

  • textile finishes
  • environmental / water and soil products in company catalogues
  • other masterbatch and compound SKUs when listed that year

How to cite

Prefer the AIM annual report or RNS over a third-party “380 company” directory. Capacity claims in trade PDFs are Unverified until the RNS number is attached.
